hotspots.title: Trump bans major media outlets from White House access
hotspots.blurb: President Trump's decision to ban CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from the White House has sparked severe backlash from press freedom groups, Democrats, and even internal criticism from MAGA allies. Critics accuse the administration of acting like a 'mad king' and violating First Amendment norms, while coverage highlights confusion around the ban's details.
hotspots.affect: Triggers intense affective investment through free speech outrage, accusations of authoritarian overreach, and rare intra-movement MAGA friction.

hotspots.title: Trump weighs renewed Iran strikes amid growing public opposition
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration is evaluating renewed military strikes against Iran as polls indicate record-high public opposition to conflict in the Middle East. Lawmakers accuse officials of lowballing war costs and casualties, even as sweeping bipartisan sanctions targeting Russia and Iran pass into law.
hotspots.affect: Commands high affective charge around war anxiety, fears of regional escalation, and public grievance over foreign policy decisions.

hotspots.title: Trump administration advances major arms sales amidst regional tensions
hotspots.blurb: The administration approved a $24.3 billion deal to sell 48 F-35 stealth fighters to Saudi Arabia despite escalating Houthi attacks in the region. National security experts and lawmakers express alarm that Chinese telecom infrastructure in Saudi Arabia could compromise America's top military tech.
hotspots.affect: Generates sharp contention between foreign policy dealmaking, regional defense escalation, and national security fears.

hotspots.title: State lawsuits and court rulings challenge Trump administration policies
hotspots.blurb: Federal judges and state officials continue to inflict legal blows on key administration initiatives, blocking SNAP benefit penalties and challenging immigration enforcement rules. Concurrently, voter advocacy groups are suing over administrative delays on state voter citizenship lists prior to midterms.
hotspots.affect: Drives polarized legal friction, executive authority pushback, and moral outrage surrounding public welfare and immigrant rights.

hotspots.title: Sweden Democrats face election setback and internal backlash
hotspots.blurb: The Sweden Democrats suffered a notable voter loss and election setback after years of continuous growth, prompting intense post-election debate. Backlash against Jimmie Åkesson's anti-Muslim rhetoric has mobilized opposition voters in key municipal strongholds, while local coalition dynamics face renewed scrutiny.
hotspots.affect: Captures high emotional charge surrounding populist party crisis, ideological backlash, and high-stakes political realignment in Sweden.
